# sudo with touch

Provide a shell function that enables Touch ID for `sudo` on macOS, following the [iMore guide](https://www.imore.com/how-use-sudo-your-mac-touch-id) (add `auth sufficient pam_tid.so` to `/etc/pam.d/sudo`). The original body is only the signature of the function to write:

```bash
func sudo_with_touch() {
  # https://www.imore.com/how-use-sudo-your-mac-touch-id
}
```

The same configuration was already the subject of [#11](DOT-11.md) in 2019; this issue presumably records the need to redo it, most likely after a macOS update had restored the stock PAM file, and to keep the recipe as a function in the dotfiles rather than as a bookmark. The function is expected to be safe to run repeatedly (no duplicate line) and to show what it changed.
